Moderating a Discussion in German: B2 Practice

Guide a discussion in German with balanced turn-taking and topic focus. Practise zu Wort kommen, beim Thema bleiben and summarising phrases.

B2 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Useful phrases and patterns

A moderator can open the topic, invite contributions and guide the group back to the question. Ich würde gern … zu Wort kommen lassen invites a speaker; Lassen Sie uns beim Thema bleiben redirects the discussion. A summary should distinguish shared points from issues still disputed.

Common mistake to avoid

An invitation to speak is not an endorsement of the statement that follows. Use attribution when summarising different participants’ views.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Ich würde gern zuerst die offenen Fragen sammeln.I would first like to collect the open questions.
Worked example 2Ich möchte auch die bisher stillen Teilnehmenden zu Wort kommen lassen.I would also like to give the participants who have been quiet a chance to speak.
Worked example 3Können wir bei der konkreten Fragestellung bleiben?Can we stay with the specific question?
Worked example 4Ich fasse kurz zusammen, worüber wir uns einig sind.I will briefly summarise what we agree on.

Practice: complete the phrases

Complete each moderation phrase using the expression or verb indicated by the cue. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: fasse · Klärungsbedarf · Thema · Wort

Question 1. Ich möchte Frau Malik zunächst zu ___ kommen lassen. (let someone speak)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: Wort

Zu Wort kommen lassen means allowing someone to speak.

Question 2. Lassen Sie uns beim ___ bleiben. (topic)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: Thema

Beim Thema bleiben asks the group to stay on topic.

Question 3. Ich ___ die bisherigen Punkte kurz zusammen. (zusammenfassen, stem)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: fasse

Zusammenfassen separates into fasse ... zusammen.

Question 4. Wo besteht noch ___? (need for clarification)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: Klärungsbedarf

Klärungsbedarf names what still needs clarification.

Revise it so it sticks
